backend/main.mo: Defines backend actor state and types for user profiles, parent‑child links, schedules, content filters, activities, locations, audit logs, and permissions, with query methods for profile access.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence metadata linking feature requirements to source files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of many frontend files describing their roles in authentication, dashboards, components, and UI flows.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining light/dark theme variables and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component handling authentication, role‑based routing, profile setup, and layout structure with policies modal.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Admin table UI for listing users with role labels and enabling/disabling accounts through backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Displays four summary metric cards for user, parent, child, and pairing counts using provided metrics.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child's daily usage summary, alerts if limits are exceeded, and allows sending a note requesting more time.
Displays a parent's view of a child’s daily screen time with alerts when limits are exceeded.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Fetches and displays a sorted audit log table for a child, showing actions, executors, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles login/logout with Internet Identity, showing loading and authenticated states.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to enter their name and choose parent or child role, then save their profile.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Lists a child's submitted activities in a sortable table with optional transparency label.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Allows children to submit activity or location entries with required consent, using tabs for each type.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Displays a transparency notice explaining what data will be shared depending on activity type.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Displays a table of a child's shared locations, sorted by timestamp, with optional transparency label.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Provides an editor for parents to configure content filter categories, allowlists, and blocklists for a child.
Shows a child's view-only version of the content filter policy, including enabled categories and lists.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Renders the app footer with year, policy link, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Displays the app header with branding, user info, theme switcher, and transparency button.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Shows a transparency notice and the child's activity history list.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Summarizes a child account with recent activity, locations shared, and selection state.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Shows a transparency notice and a list of the child's shared locations.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: UI for generating and copying a mock parent–child pairing code pending backend implementation.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Editor for setting daily screen-time limits and allowed time windows for a child.
Displays a child's read-only schedule with daily limits and allowed time windows using data from useGetSchedule.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading stored identities and managing login/logout flows.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, roles, activities, locations, and family links via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light and dark theme color variables and base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the app root with React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying user accounts, parent–child links, and aggregated metrics using tabbed navigation.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Renders the child dashboard with tabs for check-ins, history, schedule, filters, and alerts, using identity and parent data to show child-specific info.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Displays the parent dashboard with child summary cards and tabs for managing a selected child's activity, location, schedule, filters, alerts, and audit logs.
Modal page describing privacy, consent, and data policies, with scrollable sections and a close button.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL parameters, storing them in sessionStorage, and managing persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the frontend styling system.
project_state.json: Defines the project's state, feature list, architecture notes, and metadata for the parental-control web app.
